descriptionHtml:
**An aggressive and carrier-focused Midline ship-and-wing pack inspired by Diable Avionics, featuring the following:**
- 4 new battlecarriers, one for each hull type (Vent, Rafale, Trombe, Ouragan) and 1 civilian auxiliary cruiser (Alruna), all sporting the ACE Combat Suite shipsystem (+25% timeflow, -33% damage taken, enable direct control of deployed wings);
- 1 new EWAR platform (Brisenoire), lightly armed and fragile but capable of overloading enemy vessels at range;
- 7 wings, ranging from the tiny Dire Talon interceptor to the imposing Blackjack escort corvette;
- 5 pilotable and ArmA-compatible strikecrafts, 3 based on wings (Ace Dire Talon, Ace Galerne, Ace Daufin), 1 standalone (Levant drone skirmisher), 1 superfighter unique (Sorpresa experimental);
- 5 new modular weapons for your warships and aces, from the relatively mundane Scylla EMP bombs and Ultraviolet Pulsars to the massive(ly temperamental) Flamberge Demi-Cannon Array;
- 1 new hullmod, Magcoil Mounts, increasing the projectile speed of your non-beam weapons;
- 1 custom Nex start involving the Sorpresa experimental and lots of angry factions.

You can find all these wonders in Persean League and Independent markets, as well as their fleets, albeit with differing frequencies.

**Credits and thanks go to:**
- Tartiflette and the Diable crew for making Midline playstyles cool and allowing access to their code;
- Leogard for making the charging weapon code, allowing its usage and coding help in general;
- the colourful denizens of Modmaking_and_Spriting for their help in assembling this thing, providing advice, and generally being great folks;
- you, dear player, for playing this mod (and doubly so if you decide to leave constructive feedback in the pre-release thread) 🫶
